package demo;

/** Java 25's run of the same steps: each target's HEAD callbacks in Mixin's
 *  order (declaration order), then its body. */
public final class Drive {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    CounterMixin.first(null); CounterMixin.second(null); Target.twice();
    CounterMixin.third(null); Target.other();
    new Probe().onInitialize();
    CounterMixin.first(null); CounterMixin.second(null); Target.twice();
    System.out.println("read=" + Probe.read());
  }
}
